summary: Barracuda’s cloud protection for websites and APIs: nothing to install, a site connects in a few steps, and DDoS is filtered with no volume limits.
value: Websites and APIs are protected from common attacks and form abuse without your own hardware.
The site stays available during a DDoS attack.
The built-in scanner finds vulnerabilities and closes them straight away with a WAF rule while developers prepare a fix.
simple: A cloud service that protects websites and APIs: nothing to install, a site is onboarded in three steps with ready-made policies. Blocks OWASP Top 10 attacks (SQL injection, XSS, request forgery) and zero-day attacks, filters traffic by country and IP reputation (Tor, anonymous proxies, VPNs, whole networks by ASN), protects JSON and GraphQL APIs and builds rules from an OpenAPI schema. Filters DDoS with no volume limits — both volumetric and application-layer — and limits request rates. Stops password guessing, scraping, spam bots and sign-ins with stolen passwords (it checks logins against a database of leaks), and shows bots a CAPTCHA. Scans uploaded files with antivirus, masks card numbers and other sensitive data in responses, and controls third-party scripts on pages (CSP/SRI) against card theft right in the visitor’s browser (Magecart). A built-in vulnerability scanner safely tests your sites and closes the findings with WAF rules in one click (a “virtual patch”). Includes a built-in CDN, sign-in via SAML, OpenID Connect, JWT or certificates, an API dashboard (including which endpoints expose personal data), and 30 days of logs with export to one SIEM.
notIncluded: No employee access to internal applications without a VPN (ZTNA): that comes with the Premium plan.
classification: We count the Vulnerability Remediation Service (site scanning plus closing findings with rules) as DAST.
Unmetered DDoS (L3–7) maps to the DDoS protection class.
Masking card numbers in site responses is not DLP; IP reputation is not threat intelligence; CDN and SAML/OIDC sign-in stay in the text only.
